text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки has treated us all to an
absolutely
sublime show.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Фудзи Кисэки has taken first!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Cheers and yells of joy split the air and
envelop
Fuji Kiseki.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Fujiii! Sniff! She was lovelier than ever today!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member A

text_block_list.text:
She waaas! She was more amazing than
she said
she would beee!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member B

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for watching my show,
everyone!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I staked everything I had on this race, so
I hope
you had a good time!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The climax of this story will take place at
the
grand 2,500-meter track of the
Arima Kinen,
where there will be tough
opponents galore!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
"I hope you're prepared, because the
next race
will be my ultimate
masterpiece!"
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки's graceful bow is projected on
the
venue's massive monitor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She releases a white pigeon into the
sky... and
disappears.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer, I finally understand!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
When she comes back, Фудзи Кисэки's
expression is
lit up with excitement like
I've never seen on her
before.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I finally found what it is that I've been
wanting to
show everyone—and what it
looks like to run with
it!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
At last, the Arima Kinen is before our
eyes. At
2,500 meters, it's going to be a
high hurdle to
clear...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Everyone will be expecting a lot from
this climax
because of how difficult it
will be.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
In other words, it means it'll be a major
failure if I
lose.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I can already hear people saying things
like,
"Guess not even Фудзи Кисэки could
do it."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: You'll be fine. I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks. That's right. I've already
made up
my mind, after all...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm running away now. I'll
show
everyone I can reach my goal.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'll shine before everyone as the best
entertainer
ever!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's not long until the Arima Kinen. The
climax is
nigh, and so many dreams are
riding on it!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
